command:
set -eu
install -d /opt/odin-build-tools/packages
cd /opt/odin-build-tools/packages
apt-cache show python-is-python3=3.11.2-1+deb12u1
apt-get download python-is-python3=3.11.2-1+deb12u1
sha256sum python-is-python3_3.11.2-1+deb12u1_all.deb
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y --no-install-recommends install python-is-python3=3.11.2-1+deb12u1
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version}\n' python-is-python3
readlink -f /usr/bin/python
runuser -u odin-qa -- python --version
